im_channel.title: IM Channel Settings
im_channel.subtitle: Configure instant messaging platforms for Chat Agent
im_channel.unbind_confirm:
Unbind this IM channel?

The saved App ID / App Secret and the channel's conversations will be removed, the channel returns to "Not Connected", and you can bind again afterwards.
im_channel.help_desc: Configure the IM platform App ID and App Secret for Chat Agent to receive and reply messages via Feishu/WeCom/DingTalk. You can also use scan-to-configure for quick Feishu setup.
im_channel.desc_wecom: WeCom / Enterprise WeChat (smart bot, long connection)
im_channel.desc_slack: Slack · Socket Mode (Bot Token + App Token)
im_channel.desc_telegram: Telegram · Bot API (single Bot Token, getUpdates long polling)
im_channel.desc_wechat: WeChat · ilink Bot (QR binding, long polling, cards degrade to text)
im_channel.guide_feishu_s1: Open open.feishu.cn/app and create a custom app (any name, e.g. grape-assistant)
im_channel.guide_feishu_s2: In the app, add the Bot capability
im_channel.guide_feishu_s3: Copy App ID and App Secret from Credentials & Basic Info, then paste them on the right and save
im_channel.guide_feishu_s4: Under Events & Callbacks choose long connection, add im.message.receive_v1, then publish a version and wait for admin approval
im_channel.guide_feishu_tip: Easier path: use Scan to configure below to create the app and fill the credentials automatically. Long connections need no public URL; the channel connects within 30s after approval.
im_channel.guide_wecom_s1: Sign in as a WeCom admin, open App Management -> Smart Robot -> New robot
im_channel.guide_wecom_s2: Choose API mode (long connection) for message receiving; no public callback URL needed
im_channel.guide_wecom_s3: Copy Bot ID and Secret (the secret is shown only once)
im_channel.guide_wecom_s4: Paste both on the right and save; the channel connects within 30s, then mention the bot in a group or chat directly
im_channel.guide_wecom_tip: Add the target groups/members to the robot's visible scope, otherwise only admins can see it. A lost secret must be reset.
im_channel.guide_dingtalk_s1: Sign in to open-dev.dingtalk.com, create an internal enterprise app
im_channel.guide_dingtalk_s2: Copy AppKey (Client ID) and AppSecret (Client Secret) under Credentials & Basic Info
im_channel.guide_dingtalk_s3: Add the robot capability and set the message mode to Stream (long connection, no public URL)
im_channel.guide_dingtalk_s4: Paste them on the right and save, publish an app version and set the visible scope, then mention the bot in a group
im_channel.guide_dingtalk_tip: Interactive cards are optional: plain text cards work without a template; add a template ID only when you need buttons.
im_channel.guide_slack_s1: Click Copy app manifest, open api.slack.com/apps, choose Create New App -> From an app manifest and paste
im_channel.guide_slack_s2: Basic Information -> App-Level Tokens -> create an xapp-... token with connections:write
im_channel.guide_slack_s3: OAuth & Permissions -> Install to Workspace -> copy the xoxb-... token
im_channel.guide_slack_s4: Fill Bot Token and App Token on the right and save (Socket Mode is enabled by the manifest, no public URL)
im_channel.guide_slack_tip: Invite the bot to the channel first (/invite @grape), otherwise messages from that channel are not delivered.
im_channel.guide_telegram_s1: Open @BotFather in Telegram, send /newbot and pick a name
im_channel.guide_telegram_s2: Copy the token (like 123456:ABC-DEF...), paste it on the right and save
im_channel.guide_telegram_s3: Chat with the bot directly; in groups add it first, then mention it or send /command
im_channel.guide_telegram_s4: To let the bot read all group messages, send /setprivacy to @BotFather to disable privacy mode
im_channel.guide_telegram_tip: api.telegram.org must be reachable from this host; otherwise the channel stays at Configured · offline.
im_channel.guide_wechat_s1: Click Scan to bind WeChat below and scan the QR code with your phone
im_channel.guide_wechat_s2: Confirm on your phone; if a PIN is requested, enter the code shown there
im_channel.guide_wechat_s3: The channel is ready within 30s after binding and the state turns Connected
im_channel.guide_wechat_s4: Click Unbind to disconnect at any time; you can also leave from the WeChat side
im_channel.guide_wechat_tip: The WeChat ilink channel has no cards or buttons: cards degrade to title + numbered options, reply with a number to choose. Direct chats and groups are both supported.
